transactions_amount_sign.name: transactions_amount_sign
transactions_amount_sign.value:
("transactions"."type" = 'bet' AND "transactions"."amount" < 0)
        OR ("transactions"."type"::text IN ('payout', 'refund', 'daily_claim', 'signup_bonus', 'lab_reward', 'bonus_spin', 'referral', 'rain', 'lab_track', 'event_prize', 'event_refund') AND "transactions"."amount" > 0)
        OR ("transactions"."type"::text = 'event_entry' AND "transactions"."amount" < 0)
        OR ("transactions"."type"::text IN ('guest_merge', 'admin_adjust', 'tip') AND "transactions"."amount" <> 0)

transactions_game_required.name: transactions_game_required
transactions_game_required.value: "transactions"."type" NOT IN ('bet', 'payout', 'refund') OR ("transactions"."game" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."round_id" IS NOT NULL)
